# support polarity

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:supportPolarity`](gmeow-supportPolarity.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/supportPolarity>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)

Whether this evidence span supports, refutes, or is neutral toward the claim it grounds — the NLI/AIS verdict as data, orthogonal to the citations slice's [`gmeow:citationIntent`](gmeow-citationIntent.md) (which classifies a [`CitationAct`](../classes/gmeow-CitationAct.md) between works, not a span-to-claim stance). A refuting span never deletes the claim; it feeds a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) and the audit queries (P9, P10).
